SELECT *, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ') AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd FROM WORKILBO LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN FACILITY ON WORKILBO.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59')
AND CORP.CORP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{corp_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.PROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.PROD_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_no},'%')
ORDER BY ILBO_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT DEL_LOG( DEL_DATE, SESSION_NAME, ORD_DATE, DEL_KIND, CORP_NAME, PROD_NAME, PROD_NO, PROD_GYU, DEL_SU, DEL_AMNT, ORD_LOT ) SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 23), #{user_name}, ORDERT.ORD_INPUT, '작업지시', CORP.CORP_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NO, PRODUCT.PROD_GYU, WORKILBO.ILBO_SU, WORKILBO.ILBO_JUNG, ORDERT.ORD_LOT FROM WORKILBO INNER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE INNER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND WORKILBO.ILBO_CODE = #{ilbo_code} AND WORKILBO.ILBO_GUBN = #{ilbo_gubn} AND WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = #{ord_code}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM WORKILBO WHERE ilbo_code = #{ilbo_code} AND ilbo_gubn = #{ilbo_gubn} AND ord_code = #{ord_code}

SELECT *, (ORD_SU - ISNULL(danch_su,0)) AS danch_remain_su, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ') AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CASE WHEN WSTD_T43 IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE WSTD_T43 END AS wstd_t43, ISNULL(product_file_name,'no_image.png') AS product_file_name, ISNULL(wstd_chim_file_name1,'no_image.png') AS wstd_chim_file_name1 FROM ORDERT A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ord_code, SUM(ilbo_su) AS danch_su FROM WORKILBO WHERE ilbo_gubn = 'J' GROUP BY ord_code ) B ON A.ord_code = B.ord_code LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT C ON A.prod_code = C.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP D ON C.corp_code = D.corp_code LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PROD_CODE, MAX(REPLACE((CASE WHEN WSTD_T43 IS NULL OR WSTD_T43 = '' THEN '0' ELSE WSTD_T43 END),',','')) AS WSTD_T43, MAX(wstd_t32) AS WSTD_T32, MAX(wstd_t33) AS WSTD_T33, MAX(wstd_t41) AS WSTD_T41, MAX(wstd_t87) AS WSTD_T87, MAX(wstd_t44) AS WSTD_T44, MAX(wstd_t51) AS WSTD_T51, MAX(wstd_t52) AS WSTD_T52, MAX(wstd_t53) AS WSTD_T53, MAX(wstd_t54) AS WSTD_T54, MAX(wstd_t30) AS WSTD_T30, MAX(wstd_chim_file_name1) AS WSTD_CHIM_FILE_NAME1 FROM WORKSTD GROUP BY PROD_CODE ) E ON C.prod_code = E.prod_code WHERE (A.ord_su > B.danch_su OR B.danch_su IS NULL) AND A.ord_input >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
AND D.corp_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{corp_name},'%')
AND C.prod_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_name},'%')
AND C.prod_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_no},'%')
AND A.ord_code = #{ord_code}
AND A.ord_code NOT IN
#{ord_code}
ORDER BY A.ord_code

SELECT CONCAT('TK',RIGHT(REPLACE(#{ilbo_lot_date},'-',''),6),'-',#{fac_code}, (COUNT(*)+1), ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '0' WHEN COUNT(*) = 2 THEN 'A' WHEN COUNT(*) = 3 THEN 'B' ELSE 'B' END AS ilbo_lot_count FROM workilbo WHERE 1=1 AND ilbo_code = #{ilbo_code} GROUP BY ilbo_code ) ) FROM ( SELECT ILBO_LOT FROM WORKILBO WHERE 1=1 AND ILBO_STRT >= CONCAT(#{ilbo_lot_date},' 00:00:00') AND FAC_CODE = #{fac_code} AND ILBO_PN = 0 AND ILBO_GUBN = 'A' GROUP BY ILBO_LOT ) A

IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM WORKILBO WHERE 1=1 AND ILBO_PC = #{ilbo_pc} AND ILBO_GUBN = 'R' ) BEGIN SELECT *, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ') AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, ilbo_pg1 AS ilbo_pg1_sr, ilbo_pg2 AS ilbo_pg2_sr, ilbo_pg3 AS ilbo_pg3_sr, ilbo_pg4 AS ilbo_pg4_sr, ilbo_pg5 AS ilbo_pg5_sr, ilbo_ck01 AS ilbo_ck01_sr, ilbo_ck02 AS ilbo_ck02_sr, ilbo_ck03 AS ilbo_ck03_sr, ilbo_ck04 AS ilbo_ck04_sr, ilbo_ck05 AS ilbo_ck05_sr, ilbo_okng AS ilbo_okng_sr, CONCAT(prod_si,' ', prod_si1,' ~ ',prod_si2) AS prod_si, CONCAT(prod_sr,' ', prod_sr1,' ~ ',prod_sr2) AS prod_sr, 1 AS ilbo_lot_yn_chk FROM WORKILBO LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN FACILITY ON WORKILBO.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE INNER JOIN ( SELECT PROD_CODE, MAX(wstd_gj11) AS WSTD_GJ11, MAX(wstd_gj12) AS WSTD_GJ12, MAX(wstd_gj13) AS WSTD_GJ13, MAX(wstd_gj14) AS WSTD_GJ14, MAX(wstd_gj16) AS WSTD_GJ16, MAX(wstd_gj17) AS WSTD_GJ17, MAX(wstd_gj21) AS WSTD_GJ21, MAX(wstd_gj22) AS WSTD_GJ22, MAX(wstd_gj23) AS WSTD_GJ23, MAX(wstd_gj24) AS WSTD_GJ24, MAX(wstd_gj32) AS WSTD_GJ32, MAX(wstd_gj33) AS WSTD_GJ33, MAX(wstd_gj34) AS WSTD_GJ34, MAX(wstd_gj42) AS WSTD_GJ42, MAX(WSTD_READY) AS WSTD_READY, MAX(WSTD_WORKTIME) AS WSTD_WORKTIME FROM WORKSTD GROUP BY PROD_CODE ) WORKSTD ON PRODUCT.PROD_CODE = WORKSTD.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN ( SELECT ILBO_PC AS ILBO_PC_SOIP, ilbo_pg1 AS ilbo_pg1_si, ilbo_pg2 AS ilbo_pg2_si, ilbo_pg3 AS ilbo_pg3_si, ilbo_pg4 AS ilbo_pg4_si, ilbo_pg5 AS ilbo_pg5_si, ilbo_ck01 AS ilbo_ck01_si, ilbo_ck02 AS ilbo_ck02_si, ilbo_ck03 AS ilbo_ck03_si, ilbo_ck04 AS ilbo_ck04_si, ilbo_ck05 AS ilbo_ck05_si, ilbo_okng AS ilbo_okng_si FROM WORKILBO WHERE ILBO_GUBN = 'A' ) AS WORKILBO_SOIP ON WORKILBO.ILBO_PC = WORKILBO_SOIP.ILBO_PC_SOIP WHERE 1=1 AND ILBO_PC = #{ilbo_pc} AND ILBO_GUBN = 'R' END ELSE BEGIN SELECT *, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ') AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CONCAT(prod_si,' ', prod_si1,' ~ ',prod_si2) AS prod_si, CONCAT(prod_sr,' ', prod_sr1,' ~ ',prod_sr2) AS prod_sr, 0 AS ilbo_lot_yn_chk FROM WORKILBO LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN FACILITY ON WORKILBO.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE INNER JOIN ( SELECT PROD_CODE, MAX(wstd_gj11) AS WSTD_GJ11, MAX(wstd_gj12) AS WSTD_GJ12, MAX(wstd_gj13) AS WSTD_GJ13, MAX(wstd_gj14) AS WSTD_GJ14, MAX(wstd_gj16) AS WSTD_GJ16, MAX(wstd_gj17) AS WSTD_GJ17, MAX(wstd_gj21) AS WSTD_GJ21, MAX(wstd_gj22) AS WSTD_GJ22, MAX(wstd_gj23) AS WSTD_GJ23, MAX(wstd_gj24) AS WSTD_GJ24, MAX(wstd_gj32) AS WSTD_GJ32, MAX(wstd_gj33) AS WSTD_GJ33, MAX(wstd_gj34) AS WSTD_GJ34, MAX(wstd_gj42) AS WSTD_GJ42, MAX(WSTD_READY) AS WSTD_READY, MAX(WSTD_WORKTIME) AS WSTD_WORKTIME FROM WORKSTD GROUP BY PROD_CODE ) WORKSTD ON PRODUCT.PROD_CODE = WORKSTD.PROD_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND ILBO_PC = #{ilbo_pc} AND ILBO_GUBN = 'A' END

SELECT WI.ILBO_LOT, WI.ILBO_STRT, WI.ILBO_END, WI.ILBO_GUBN,
FAC.FAC_NAME,
CORP.CORP_NAME, PROD.PROD_NAME, PROD.PROD_NO, PROD.PROD_JAI, PROD.PROD_GYU,
WI.ILBO_G11 AS WSTD_GJ11, WI.ILBO_G12 AS WSTD_GJ12, WI.ILBO_G13 AS WSTD_GJ13, WI.ILBO_G14 AS WSTD_GJ14, WI.ILBO_G21 AS WSTD_GJ15, WI.ILBO_G22 AS WSTD_GJ18,
WI.ILBO_G23 AS WSTD_GJ21, WI.ILBO_G24 AS WSTD_GJ22, WI.ILBO_G25 AS WSTD_GJ23, WI.ILBO_G26 AS WSTD_GJ24, WI.ILBO_G27 AS WSTD_GJ25, WI.ILBO_G31 AS WSTD_GJ28,
WI.ILBO_G32 AS WSTD_GJ31, WI.ILBO_G33 AS WSTD_GJ32, WI.ILBO_G34 AS WSTD_GJ33, WI.ILBO_G35 AS WSTD_GJ34, WI.ILBO_G41 AS WSTD_GJ35, WI.ILBO_G42 AS WSTD_GJ38,
WI.ILBO_G43 AS TRACKING_HEAT, WI.ILBO_G44 AS TRACKING_CHIM, WI.ILBO_G51 AS TRACKING_DIFF, WI.ILBO_G52 AS TRACKING_GANG, WI.ILBO_G53 AS TRACKING_COLD,
WI.ILBO_PG1 AS ILBO_PG1_SI, WI.ILBO_PG2 AS ILBO_PG2_SI, WI.ILBO_PG3 AS ILBO_PG3_SI, WI.ILBO_PG4 AS ILBO_PG4_SI, WI.ILBO_PG5 AS ILBO_PG5_SI,
WI.ILBO_G54 AS ILBO_PG1_SR, WI.ILBO_G61 AS ILBO_PG2_SR, WI.ILBO_G62 AS ILBO_PG3_SR, WI.ILBO_G63 AS ILBO_PG4_SR, WI.ILBO_G64 AS ILBO_PG5_SR
FROM WORKILBO WI LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ORD ON WI.ORD_CODE = ORD.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT PROD ON ORD.PROD_CODE = PROD.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PROD.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN FACILITY FAC ON WI.FAC_CODE = FAC.FAC_CODE
WHERE WI.ILBO_LOT = #{ilbo_lot} AND WI.ILBO_GUBN IN ('A', 'R')
ORDER BY WI.ILBO_STRT
